title: Luxury Cowboy Speakeasy, Billiards 3min to Stadium
description:
The ultimate group HQ just 3 minutes from Nissan Stadium and the heart of East Nashville. This 4-bedroom luxury townhome features 3 King beds, 2-car garage parking, and a private Speakeasy lounge in the garage with pool, shuffleboard, and air hockey. Whether you’re here for a stadium concert or a Broadway weekend, you have the space to host everyone without the downtown noise.

The space
Designed for Groups  
Unlike rentals with bunk beds, this property offers three dedicated King suites plus a Queen room, ensuring real sleep quality for every guest.

Speakeasy & Game Lounge  
⊙ Professionally converted, climate‑controlled garage with:
⊙ 3‑in‑1 gaming table (Pool, Air Hockey, Foosball)
⊙ Shuffleboard & Darts
⊙ Full bar seating, Smart TV, and high‑top stools
⊙ Ideal for pre‑game drinks or late‑night tournaments.

Sleep Layout – High‑End Linens
⊙ Bedroom 1: King Bed (En‑suite)
⊙ Bedroom 2: King Bed
⊙ Bedroom 3: King Bed
⊙ Bedroom 4: Queen Bed
⊙ Living Room: Sleeper Sofa (sleeps 2)

Bathrooms  
Three full bathrooms, including one with a soaking tub.

Amenities  
Fully stocked kitchen with appliances and cookware, Smart TVs in every bedroom and living room, high‑speed Wi‑Fi, washer/dryer with detergent, and 100% digital contactless check‑in. Cleaning with organic, green supplies.

Location
⊙ Nissan Stadium: 3 minutes (0.9 miles)
⊙ Broadway/Downtown: 6 minutes by Uber
⊙ East Nashville Hotspots: 4 minutes to Five Points dining/bars
⊙ Parking: Private garage + driveway (2–3 cars total)

The Logistics
Check-in: 100% digital and contactless.
Internet: High-speed Wi-Fi throughout for remote work or streaming.
Cleaning: We use organic, green supplies to ensure a fresh, chemical-free stay.

Guest access
The entire space is yours. Please make yourself at home. We utilize a digital lock with your own unique code that is emailed to you two days before check-in.

Other things to note
🤝 You will need to sign our Guest Agreement before the system releases check-in instructions
🌿 We use green & organic cleaning supplies
📅 Book now for a weekend filled with music, memories, and all the Nashville magic!
